text: Electronegativity is the ability of an atom in a molecule to attract shared electrons.
When the electronegativity difference between two atoms is small, the electrons are shared and the bond is covalent; when it is large, one atom takes the electrons and the bond is ionic.
In a sodium chloride crystal, six chloride ions surround each sodium ion, and six sodium ions surround each chloride ion.
A balanced chemical equation has the same number and type of each atom on both sides.
